settlements.54: The eyebrows above every heading are gone. Each Hallmark page opens on the heading itself.

settlements.38ii: The italic word in the headline is gone. The headings are roman.
settlements.85: The email sign-up is gone. The stamp records the drop of #newsletter and the email field, because gate 85 names that closer on a buy page.
settlements.46a: The line "Trusted by 50,000+" is gone. That count is not in the sample catalog, and the stamp records the drop.
settlements.19: The buzzwords and the Jane Doe quote are gone. The headings those gates named are listed in the stamp as reworded.
settlements.30a: The emoji tiles are gone. The pages use credited Wikimedia photographs in the theme slots.
settlements.2a: The purple-to-blue gradient on the headline, the button, and the empty frame is gone. Each theme uses its own accent as solid ink.
settlements.4: The card nested inside a card is gone. Each page keeps one containment layer.
settlements.63: The arrow glued to "Get started" and the middle-dot eyebrow are gone. The actions are verb labels.
settlements.7a: The pure white fills are gone. Paper and ink come from the theme tokens.
settlements.7b: The white paper token is gone. Each scaffold tints the paper toward the theme.
settlements.10a: transition: all is gone. The theme buttons list the properties they animate.
settlements.15: The focus ring no longer animates. The scaffold ring appears at once.
settlements.34: overflow-x: hidden is gone. The scaffold uses overflow-x: clip, and the phone layout stacks.
settlements.40: The gradient buttons that failed contrast are gone. Labels sit on the theme's accent ink.
settlements.48: The loose hex colors are gone. Color lives in tokens.css.
settlements.49a: The wrapping "Get started" control is gone. The reserve action is a short label.
settlements.55a: The uppercase heading at line-height 0.94 is gone. Display headings keep a line-height of at least 1.
settlements.58: The default hero's three text blocks before the action are gone. Hallmark still leaves a note on the redesigns: one screen holds about 88 to 103 words. That note is unsettled.
settlements.67: The tracked uppercase eyebrows and table heads are gone. Labels use the body face.
settlements.1: Poppins is gone. Halftone uses Ultra, Arcade uses Bungee, and Hum uses Chillax, the faces the dealt themes name.
settlements.3: The three equal icon tiles are gone.
settlements.24b: The off-scale padding is gone. Spacing uses the scaffold's 4px tokens.
settlements.25: The wide measure is gone. Body copy uses the scaffold's 65ch cap.
settlements.26b: The pages now style :active and :disabled. Disabled controls set fill, ink, and cursor.
settlements.49b: The part names that wrapped on a 320px screen stay on one line. The phone layout stacks the price under the name.
settlements.71: The headings sit with the section they introduce, on the scaffold's section rhythm.
settlements.77: The thin pickup block is now a row of the four stores, wide enough for the 1440px check.
settlements.78: Section headings use the scaffold's --text-section size.
settlements.81: The empty gradient frame is gone. Photographs sit in the theme slots.
settlements.42: The default hairline nav is gone. Halftone and Arcade use a banner, and Hum uses a slab.
settlements.74: The Tailwind slate tokens are gone. The themes mix their own OKLCH colors.
settlements.F1: The straight-quote testimonial is gone with the Jane Doe line.
settlements.F3: Headings use text-wrap: balance from the scaffold.
settlements.F23: Each redesigned page has a meta description.
settlements.F24: The hairline-plus-soft-shadow card is gone. Each theme commits to its own edge.
